setup.rulesText:
Welcome to TeamFlow — BGL Buy & Sell.

• Open a ticket in 💎┃buy-sell to buy or sell BGL.
• Only deal with staff inside your ticket. Never trust anyone who DMs you first.
• Payment is arranged by staff in the ticket. Prices are in 🏷️┃prices.
• Completed deals are logged in ✅┃completed-deals.
• Be respectful. Staff decisions are final.
setup.pricesText:
💎 **BGL PRICES**

**1 BGL = €4**

**We accept:** USDT · USDC · LTC · BTC · ETH (stable crypto preferred)

Rates can change with the market — open a ticket in 💎┃buy-sell for the live price. Staff confirm the final rate inside your ticket.
